fields.Name: SQL Server
fields.Description: Ingest data from an external Microsoft SQL Server (incl. Azure SQL) via a shared MJ: External Data Sources connection. Schema is discovered at connection time; the connector delegates connectivity to the EDS 'SQLServerExternalDriver' driver.

Configuration.note: Bind this connection to a shared 'MJ: External Data Sources' row by setting Configuration.externalDataSourceID on the CompanyIntegration. Host + credentials live on that EDS row (credentials via CredentialEngine); objects/fields are discovered at connection time. Requires @memberjunction/external-data-sources + @memberjunction/external-data-source-sqlserver >= 5.46.0.
